recommendation: Keep the live SOL Range Onset route unchanged. Reopen only the report-only hourly-cross relaxation hypothesis because a new source-bound executable-BBO matrix produced a positive short-side lead under every predeclared context cohort.
why_now: Revision 2 rejected relaxation from completed-candle readiness paths. The new current-run matrix is stronger execution evidence: it selects exact one-blocker directional candidates, enforces v51 notional, entry-delay, stop-proxy, depth, official funding, and non-overlap, and remains positive after largest-winner removal. This is new evidence, but it is not route-native exit evidence and remains too small and one-sided for a live change.
observed_problem_or_opportunity: The hourly SMA10/30 crossover is the sole blocker on 310 SOL evaluations. Exact one-blocker replays resolved three to five non-overlapping short episodes depending on the predeclared context cohort. Every cohort was positive after costs and largest-winner removal, unlike the broader readiness-path study.
applicable_market_regime: Current-run SOL short structural direction when the 5-minute regime admits the trade but no fresh hourly SMA10/30 crossover exists.
alternatives_considered: Remove the hourly-cross requirement live now, rejected because only three to five short episodes resolved and the replay uses a fixed 60-minute horizon rather than v51 route-native exits.
Add the dual-MTF context challenger as a live gate, rejected because aligned, opposed, and all cohorts were all positive and do not establish a discriminating context edge.
Keep the hypothesis rejected, rejected because the new executable-BBO evidence satisfies the explicit new-evidence rule for reopening research.
Continue unchanged live execution while collecting a predeclared route-native shadow, selected.
expected_upside: A route-native shadow can determine whether the hourly crossover is suppressing repeatable SOL shorts without risking capital or fitting a new threshold to three favorable observations.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: All resolved episodes are short; long behavior is unobserved.
The aligned, opposed, and all cohorts overlap and cannot be pooled as independent PnL.
The fixed 60-minute exit plus 80-bps stop proxy does not model opposite-signal, profit-lock, or maximum-hold behavior of a live lifecycle.
BBO depth replay estimates IOC execution but does not prove a live fill.
Three to five episodes can be ordinary variance, and the best all-cohort result still contains one loss.
The current run is one market window with short-only structural direction.
validation_completed: The immutable matrix is bound to the exact v51 run and active config path.
All six official funding bundles cover 2026-08-14T07:00:00Z through 2026-08-14T19:00:00Z with complete hourly evidence.
The matrix found four exact executable one-blocker hypotheses and produced twelve fixed cohort comparisons.
SOL aligned resolved 3/3 wins, +60.6723 bps total, +22.9009 bps excluding its largest winner.
SOL opposed resolved 5 trades, 3W/2L, +51.0256 bps total, PF 4.7948, +11.6552 bps excluding its largest winner.
SOL all resolved 3 trades, 2W/1L, +57.3147 bps total, PF 6.3915, +11.7202 bps excluding its largest winner.
No SOL stop-proxy crossing occurred in any resolved cohort.
validation_still_required: Predeclare and collect later independent exact-one-blocker episodes without changing the blocker or thresholds.
Replay the exact v51 route-native exit hierarchy: stop, eligible opposite signal, any configured profit protection, and maximum-hold fallback.
Resolve long-side episodes or explicitly retain long-side absence as a coverage result.
Use exact future fees, funding, depth, latency, and missed-entry accounting.
Require chronological stability and positive largest-winner sensitivity on a materially larger independent sample.
Compare against the unchanged canonical route and taking no action.
success_metrics: At least ten independent resolved short episodes and three resolved long episodes, or an explicitly time-bounded long-side coverage failure.
Positive after-cost net and profit factor above one under route-native exits.
Positive net after removing the largest winner and no dependence on a single context cohort.
No increase in stop-cross rate, unresolved depth, stale-entry, or route-attribution failures relative to v51.
The challenger improves net opportunity capture versus the unchanged canonical route without increasing modeled portfolio stop-wave concentration.
failure_or_rollback_triggers: Route-native exits make the independent sample non-positive after costs or largest-winner removal.
The apparent edge disappears outside short structural direction or depends on one episode.
Exact execution friction, depth, or latency materially exceeds the matrix assumptions.
A profile, sizing, stop, signal-source, or exit-policy change invalidates the frozen comparison.
Any research/live candidate identity mismatch or look-ahead contamination is found.

minimum_additional_evidence.to_update_diagnosis: One later independent fully resolved route-native short episode and any attributable long episode.
minimum_additional_evidence.for_change_recommendation: A predeclared later window meeting the success metrics with exact v51 exits and costs.

decision: Reopen research only; preserve all live SOL strategy, blocker, sizing, leverage, stop, exit, and routing behavior.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Build the predeclared SOL hourly-cross one-blocker shadow with exact v51 route-native exit precedence, then accumulate later independent long and short episodes.
limitations: This revision contains no live change proposal and requests no approval.
Results are fixed-horizon opportunity diagnostics rather than executed trade PnL.
The three context cohorts overlap and are sensitivity views, not twelve independent strategies.
The matrix cannot submit, close, resize, or alter a live lifecycle.
